skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Seeker SK03
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SK03. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those go-getter explorers.
skins.quote: Croissant has prepared a lot for the field trip. She'll surely make a fortune out of it!

skins.name: Seven in the Morning
skins.content: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Seven in the Morning. Designed by Croissant. Actually just recycled Exusiai's design because it's cheaper to do it that way.
